system.description: A permanent, always-on power. Anyone feeding on the Gangrel must win a Self-Control Test against four Traits or enter frenzy immediately. Anyone attempting to diablerize the Gangrel must spend one Willpower point per turn of the attempt. A successful diablerist suffers a permanent one-Trait penalty on all future frenzy checks (and falls into Wassail at Self-Control 1 instead of 0), plus a recurring Willpower Test contest against the consumed Gangrel's Beast (weekly for year one, monthly for year two, yearly thereafter) — the loser of each contest permanently loses a Willpower Trait.
